title: StoneFortune
description: StoneFortune allows players to find items alongside stones while mining and maximizes the Mining experience!
body:
Hello everyone! I would like to introduce my first plugin: StoneFortune. It’s a lightweight and performance-friendly plugin designed to make the mining experience on your server much more rewarding and fun!

## **✨ Key Features:**
Lucky Mines: Players have a chance to find rewards (like diamonds) while mining Stone or Deepslate.

## **️ Anti-Exploit System:** 
Players cannot cheat by placing blocks they've collected with Silk Touch. The plugin only rewards for naturally generated blocks!

## **⚙️ Fully Customizable:** 
You can easily adjust the reward item, drop chance, and sound effects via config.yml.

Language Support: All messages are customizable in messages.yml.

## **⚡ Ultra Lightweight:**
Designed with performance in mind, it won't lag your server.

## **️Commands & Permissions:**
/stoneluck reload - Reloads the configuration files. (Permission: stoneluck.admin)

## **Planned Updates:**
Title & Broadcast: Show a message on the player's screen or broadcast to the whole server when someone finds a rare reward.

Combo Rewards: Extra bonuses for finding multiple rare items in a row.

Multi-Language Support: Built-in English, Turkish, and more options selectable via config.

More Sound Effects: A wider variety of sounds for different reward tiers.


Note: This is my first-ever plugin! I am committed to improving it over time and fixing any bugs that might arise. Thank you for your support!
